itinerary.title: Arrival at VCE — LY 289
itinerary.description: Use the existing protected calendar flight. Times here are Europe/Rome local time; do not recreate or modify the flight event.

itinerary.title: VCE → Mestre lodging
itinerary.description: Airport transfer, late check-in, water and a light snack. Keep the first night car-free.

itinerary.title: Check-in — a&o Venezia Mestre
itinerary.description: Confirmed two-night stay for two adults. Expected arrival is after the flight and airport transfer; notify the property about late arrival if required.

itinerary.title: San Marco and central Venice
itinerary.description: Early train/bus into Venice; Piazza San Marco, exterior landmarks and a slow walk before crowds peak.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Venice
itinerary.description: Reserve or choose a simple bacaro away from the most tourist-heavy frontage.

itinerary.title: Affordable Venetian mask shop
itinerary.description: Buy only after confirming the exact budget shop in Chrome; avoid an unplanned premium artisan purchase.

itinerary.title: Murano afternoon
itinerary.description: Vaporetto to Murano, short island walk and return before a late dinner. Drop if transit or weather is poor.

metadata.fallback: Stay in Cannaregio and return to Mestre early.

itinerary.title: Rialto and final Venice walk
itinerary.description: Early Rialto area walk, coffee and return to Mestre for luggage.

itinerary.title: Lunch before car pickup
itinerary.description: Quick lunch near Mestre/VCE; leave margin for rental paperwork.

itinerary.title: Pick up rental car at VCE
itinerary.description: Inspect the car, photograph existing damage, confirm toll/fuel rules and load offline maps.

itinerary.title: Drive — VCE → Lago di Centro Cadore
itinerary.description: Leave immediately after collecting the car and use the direct route to Pieve di Cadore; skip the stop if traffic removes the daylight margin.

metadata.fallback: Drive directly to Cortina and stop only at a service area.

itinerary.title: Lago di Centro Cadore — first Dolomites stop
itinerary.description: Short easy lakeside viewpoint, restroom and snack break. Keep it to 30 minutes so the final mountain drive remains in daylight.

itinerary.title: Drive — Lago di Centro Cadore → Cortina east base
itinerary.description: Continue to the east base, check in, buy groceries and prepare water and sandwiches for the next morning.

itinerary.title: Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop
itinerary.description: Arrive at Rifugio Auronzo parking by 07:30–08:00. Light-medium 10 km loop, 4–5 hours; carry layers, water and sandwiches.

itinerary.title: Packed lunch on the Tre Cime route
itinerary.description: Eat the packed lunch when the route and weather allow; do not rely on rifugi service.

itinerary.title: Lago di Misurina recovery stop
itinerary.description: Optional easy lakeside recovery stop; skip if the hike runs late or weather worsens.

itinerary.title: Lago di Braies: boat and loop
itinerary.description: Use reserved parking, arrive early, take a 45-minute shared boat if operating, then complete the easy lake loop.

metadata.fallback: Dobbiaco and San Candido easy town day

itinerary.title: Lunch near Braies/Dobbiaco
itinerary.description: Choose a reserved or low-friction lunch after leaving the lakeshore crowd.

itinerary.title: Dobbiaco or Cortina rest afternoon
itinerary.description: Easy café/town time, laundry and weather check for the next two mountain days.

itinerary.title: Cinque Torri by chairlift
itinerary.description: Take the 5 Torri chairlift and do a light loop among the towers and open-air WWI sites.

itinerary.title: Lunch at Rifugio Averau
itinerary.description: Target a booked table or carry a backup snack if access or service changes.

itinerary.title: Passo Giau scenic stop
itinerary.description: Short viewpoint stop on the return drive; no second major hike.

itinerary.title: Lagazuoi cable car and viewpoints
itinerary.description: First cable car, easy summit viewpoints and optional short tunnel section only if conditions are comfortable.

itinerary.title: Lunch near Falzarego
itinerary.description: Warm lunch after descending; keep the afternoon intentionally light.

itinerary.title: Cortina rest and supplies
itinerary.description: Rest, groceries and recheck forecasts, lift notices and road conditions.

itinerary.title: East-base weather buffer
itinerary.description: Use for the highest-priority missed east anchor; if all completed, take a slow Cortina/Misurina morning.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Cortina
itinerary.description: Unhurried lunch and recovery before changing bases.

itinerary.title: Laundry, fuel and pack for transfer
itinerary.description: Refuel, organize the car and download the next day’s scenic route offline.

itinerary.title: Scenic transfer Cortina → Ortisei
itinerary.description: Drive the scenic pass route only if weather and roads are good; otherwise use the safer direct route.

itinerary.title: Transfer-day lunch
itinerary.description: Stop where parking is simple; avoid a fixed mountain reservation that could pressure the drive.

itinerary.title: Ortisei check-in and orientation
itinerary.description: Check in, locate both lift stations, buy groceries and verify guest-card transport benefits.

itinerary.title: Seceda ridge morning
itinerary.description: Take the first practical lift from Ortisei and follow a light-medium ridge walk, turning back early if cloud builds.

metadata.fallback: Ortisei village and Val Gardena museum

itinerary.title: Lunch on/under Seceda
itinerary.description: Choose a hut with confirmed service or descend for lunch in Ortisei.

itinerary.title: Ortisei recovery afternoon
itinerary.description: No second mountain anchor; rest and review the next day’s operating notice.

itinerary.title: Alpe di Siusi from Ortisei
itinerary.description: Use the Ortisei cable car for a broad meadow walk with an easy turnaround and weather-aware pacing.

itinerary.title: Lunch on Alpe di Siusi
itinerary.description: Preselect one hut and keep a packed backup in case of closure or queues.

itinerary.title: Easy return and rest
itinerary.description: Return without adding another hike; use the afternoon for recovery.

itinerary.title: Val di Funes and Santa Maddalena
itinerary.description: Scenic village walk and church viewpoints; continue to Zannes only if parking is confirmed.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Val di Funes
itinerary.description: Choose a valley restaurant with parking; retain flexibility around the scenic stops.

itinerary.title: Zannes easy loop (optional)
itinerary.description: Only a short easy loop; skip if the morning was long or parking is unavailable.

itinerary.title: West-base weather buffer
itinerary.description: Repeat the highest-priority west anchor missed due to weather; otherwise take a gentle local walk.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Ortisei
itinerary.description: Flexible lunch after the buffer activity.

itinerary.title: Free afternoon
itinerary.description: Rest, café, crafts or laundry; intentionally unscheduled for resilience.

itinerary.title: Passo Gardena scenic morning
itinerary.description: Weather-dependent scenic drive with short viewpoints, not a major exposed hike.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Val Gardena
itinerary.description: Lunch in Selva/Santa Cristina with simple parking.

itinerary.title: Optional Vallunga easy walk
itinerary.description: Flat recovery walk only if energy and weather are good.

itinerary.title: Final Dolomites flex morning
itinerary.description: Use for a missed Plan A anchor or keep as a relaxed Ortisei morning; no forced checklist completion.

itinerary.title: Farewell lunch in Ortisei
itinerary.description: Book a pleasant but cancellable final-base lunch.

itinerary.title: Pack, fuel and car check
itinerary.description: Prepare for the long transfer, confirm VCE return instructions and download the route.

itinerary.title: Drive Ortisei → Veneto
itinerary.description: Use the direct route; Conegliano is an optional lunch stop only if traffic and timing are comfortable.

itinerary.title: Lunch near Conegliano/Veneto
itinerary.description: Flexible transfer lunch with easy parking; skip the old town if arrival margin shrinks.

itinerary.title: Return rental car at VCE
itinerary.description: Refuel according to contract, photograph the car and keep the return receipt.

itinerary.title: Final night in Mestre
itinerary.description: Check in near transport, repack for flight and keep the evening simple.

itinerary.title: Mestre → VCE
itinerary.description: Leave with at least 2.5 hours at the airport for the 12:05 local departure.

itinerary.title: Departure from VCE — LY 290
itinerary.description: Use the existing protected calendar flight. Times here are Europe/Rome local time; do not recreate or modify the flight event.

lodgingCandidates.title: Hotel Bellaria – Cortina d'Ampezzo – parking

lodgingCandidates.title: Barisetti Sport Hotel

lodgingCandidates.title: Garni Kostner

lodgingCandidates.title: B&B Hotel Mirabel
lodgingCandidates.notes: Strong 9.7 rating from 489 reviews; pricier than Garni Kostner.

lodgingCandidates.title: Hotel Genziana
lodgingCandidates.notes: Most central route fit of the three; higher cost.

lodgingCandidates.title: Campanile Venice Mestre
lodgingCandidates.notes: One-night transport-focused candidate; confirm early VCE transfer before booking.
